title: Rabbi Yochanan bar Papa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bereshit Rabbah 45:4, Rabbi Azariah reports a teaching in his name. Hyman also cites Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:8 and suggests that the name should read Rabbi Chanina bar Papa.

notes.text: The notice does not specify whether the proposed Chanina correction applies to both passages or only the second.

The saved whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah45:4 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Azariah reporting Rabbi Yochanan bar Pappa; supplied44:4 remains visible alongside that match. The saved whole Vilna1878 Maharzu scalar proposes R’ Chanina bar Pappa, citing Shir HaShirim Rabbah and Arukh; neither cited work is thereby newly inspected. The tentative Hyman emendation and its one-or-both-passages scope remain unresolved, and no numbering or glyph-history explanation is proved.

Hyman’s print (vol. II, p. 685) gives Bereshit Rabbah 45:4, where the supplied Hebrew gives 44:4. The consulted Bereshit Rabbah passage has Azariah reporting in the name of Yochanan bar Papa. In the parallel at Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14:8, Azariah reports the same teaching in the name of Chanina bar Papa. Maharzu on Bereshit Rabbah also proposes Chanina. Hyman does not specify whether his proposed correction applies to one citation or both.
